BREVO_API_KEY.description: Optional. Your Brevo key from **Brevo → SMTP & API → API Keys**, created as **Restricted** with **Transactional email** set to **All** and **Account** set to **Read**. You can also leave this empty and paste the key on nimbox's setup page.

MAIL.description: Holds the original copy of every email and attachment.

MAILBOX.description: Keeps the list of conversations for each address.

DIRECTORY.description: Keeps the list of your addresses.

UPDATER.description: Keeps the GitHub connection used to install nimbox updates.
